scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits among his followers at sunset, gesturing gently and resting a hand on one man's shoulder as they listen.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus with his own before Passover, expressing the verse's account of his enduring love as his hour to depart to the Father approaches. The setting and gestures are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus and companions share supper in a warmly lit room, while a troubled Judas sits nearby with a dark wisp curling behind him.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the supper in John 13:2; the dark wisp symbolizes the devil having already placed the intention to betray Jesus in Judas's heart.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands beneath an olive tree with light glowing between his open hands, looking toward a radiant sky above a winding path through a sunlit landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses the light in Jesus' hands and the path toward the sky to evoke John 13:3: he knows the Father has given all things into his hands, and that he came from God and is going to God.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands beside a supper table and ties a white towel around his waist, while seated companions look on and an outer garment rests nearby.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 13:4: he rises from supper, lays aside his garments, takes a towel and girds himself.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus kneels beside a seated disciple, wiping his wet foot with a towel over a basin as other disciples watch in a warmly lit room.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 13:5: Jesus washes the disciples' feet and wipes them with the towel around his waist; the room and figures are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Simon Peter sits barefoot, gesturing in surprise toward Jesus, who kneels beside a basin of water holding a cloth in a warmly lit room.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus coming to Simon Peter and Peter asking whether the Lord is washing his feet. The room, appearances, and gestures are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks gently while washing a seated man’s foot in a basin; the man listens with a thoughtful, uncertain expression in a warmly lit room.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus answering a man who does not yet understand what Jesus is doing, but will know afterward. The setting and depicted action are artistic details, not stated in this verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Peter sits with his bare feet drawn back and his hands raised as Jesus kneels beside a basin of water, holding a cloth and looking toward him. Other men watch in a warmly lit room.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Peter's refusal to let Jesus wash his feet and Jesus' reply that without being washed Peter has no part with him (John 13:8). The setting and poses are artistic interpretation; the excerpt's English token glosses are from the Berean Interlinear.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Simon Peter sits barefoot beside a basin, gesturing toward his head and raised hand as Jesus kneels nearby holding a towel and listens.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Simon Peter's request to the Lord in John 13:9: not his feet only, but also his hands and head. The setting and gestures are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus kneels and washes a seated man's foot over a basin as several listeners look on in a warmly lit room.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus speaking about the person who has bathed needing only to wash the feet, and telling his listeners that they are clean, though not all are clean.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks among disciples in a warm, lamplit room, while one man sits apart in thought; a basin of water and folded cloth rest in the foreground.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for John 13:11: Jesus knows the one betraying him, which is why he says that not all are clean. The room, gestures, basin and expressions are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus reclines among attentive disciples around a low table, speaking with an open hand; a basin of water and folded cloth rest in the foreground.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts John 13:12 after Jesus has washed their feet, taken His garments, and reclined again to ask the disciples whether they know what He has done for them. The room and visual details are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits in a warmly lit room and gestures as a small group of followers listen attentively.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus speaking to his followers, reflecting John 13:13, where they call him Teacher and Lord and he affirms that they speak rightly. The setting and gestures are imagined; the English token glosses in the supplied excerpt are from the Berean Interlinear Bible.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus kneels beside a basin, washing a seated disciple's foot while other disciples watch; one holds a cloth in the warmly lit room.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting John 13:14: the Lord and Teacher washes his disciples' feet and calls them to wash one another's feet.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus offers a cup of water to a seated disciple, while another disciple offers a cup to a companion in a warmly lit room.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the verse’s pattern of following an example through shared acts of service; the verse does not specify these cups of water.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a man gestures to a departing messenger while a servant holds a water jug nearby.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene evoking the verse's comparisons of a servant with his master and a messenger with the one who sent him; the pictured actions are not stated in the verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a kneeling man washes a seated man's foot in a basin while three companions look on and offer encouragement and a towel.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative act of care pictures the verse's relationship between knowing, doing, and being blessed; the verse itself does not specify this scene.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks to companions gathered around a table of bread as a man holding bread turns away, his raised heel visible.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes John 13:18: Jesus speaks of one who eats his bread and lifts his heel against him. The departing figure and visible heel are an artistic interpretation, not a claim that the verse describes a literal departure or kick.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with an open hand to attentive disciples gathered around a low table in a warmly lamplit room.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of Jesus telling his listeners beforehand so that they may believe when it comes to pass, as expressed in John 13:19. The setting and figures are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman welcomes a travelling disciple at a village doorway while Jesus and other disciples stand on the sunlit path behind him.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a household welcoming a messenger sent by Jesus, illustrating his teaching that receiving the one he sends is receiving him, and that receiving him is receiving the One who sent him.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with a troubled expression and a hand to his chest as listeners gather around a table and watch with concern.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus, troubled in spirit, telling those with him that one of them will betray him. The setting and individual expressions are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Disciples around a table exchange questioning glances as their teacher speaks in a warmly lit room.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the disciples looking at one another, uncertain whom he is speaking about in John 13:22.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus reclines beside a low meal table, with a disciple resting against his chest as Jesus embraces him; other diners appear in the foreground of a warmly lit room.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the disciple whom Jesus loved reclining in Jesus' bosom in John 13:23; the setting, appearance, and details are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a warmly lit room, Simon Peter gestures toward an attentive man beside him as another man looks on across a meal.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Simon Peter motioning to a man and telling him to ask who is being spoken about in John 13:24.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man leans close against Jesus and looks up as he speaks; Jesus listens beside him at a table in a warmly lit room.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 13:25: the man leans on Jesus' breast and asks him who it is. The room, clothing and other visual details are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus offers a dipped morsel of bread to Judas across a warmly lit table, with a shallow dish and other diners nearby.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 13:26, where Jesus dips a morsel and gives it to Judas, son of Simon Iscariot.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus addresses a troubled man holding a morsel of bread at a lamplit meal, as a shadow rises behind him and others look on.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes John 13:27: after the morsel, Satan enters the man, and Jesus tells him to do quickly what he is doing. The shadow is a visual metaphor, not a depiction specified by the verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man speaks quietly to another at a low meal table while reclining diners look on with puzzled expressions in a warmly lit room.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the uncertainty of those reclining, who did not know why he spoke to the other man in John 13:28. The setting and gestures are artistic interpretation, guided by the supplied Berean Interlinear glosses.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures toward Judas, who holds a small money bag, as companions watch thoughtfully around a meal in a warmly lit room.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the moment behind John 13:29: some thought Jesus was telling Judas, who had the money bag, to buy what was needed for the feast or give something to the poor.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man holding a morsel of bread steps briskly from a lamplit doorway into a moonlit night.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the verse: after receiving the morsel, he went out immediately, and it was night. The setting and appearance are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks to attentive listeners around a table in a warmly lit room, while a man walks away through an open doorway.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for John 13:31: after someone has gone out, Jesus speaks of the Son of Man and God being glorified in Him. The room, listeners and warm light are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits in a stone room, looking upward as warm golden light fills the space around him.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses radiant light to suggest the verse's words about God being glorified in Him and glorifying Him immediately; it does not depict an event described in the verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks gently to a circle of attentive disciples in a warmly lamplit room, with a doorway open to the night.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus addressing his followers with tenderness as he tells them that he is with them only a little while and that they cannot come where he is going.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with open hands to disciples gathered in a sunlit stone courtyard; one disciple rests a reassuring hand on another's shoulder.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene reflects Jesus' new commandment to love one another as he has loved his disciples; the setting and gestures are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village courtyard, companions comfort a weary man and offer him bread while nearby villagers watch.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene illustrates the verse’s teaching that people will recognize Jesus’ disciples by their love for one another; the particular encounter is not narrated in the verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Peter looks toward Jesus with a questioning gesture as Jesus gestures toward a sunlit path, in a warm watercolor courtyard scene.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Simon Peter asking where Jesus is going and Jesus saying Peter cannot follow now but will follow afterward; the courtyard and gestures are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Peter speaks earnestly to Jesus, one hand against his chest and the other extended, as Jesus listens in a warmly lit room.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Peter asking why he cannot follow the Lord now and declaring that he will lay down his life for Him in John 13:37. The room and visual details are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks gently to a troubled disciple seated beside him in a lamplit stone courtyard at night, while a quiet rooster stands on a nearby wall.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Jesus's question about laying down one's life and his prediction that the listener will deny him three times before a rooster crows. The setting and visible rooster are artistic choices.
